title: Pensive Elderly Woman in Floral Dress, June 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot of an elderly woman standing outdoors on a walkway beside a cedar shingle house with large white-trimmed multipane windows. She wears a patterned floral day dress trimmed with contrasting white piping along the neckline and pockets. The upper margin is processed with the date stamp 'JUN • 56'.
